description: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission publishes Event Notification Reports, the notifications that licensees make to the NRC operations centre about events at reactors and materials licensees. The page, read on 2026-09-26 and last reviewed on 16 September 2026, gives yearly indexes of the reports from 1999 to 2026, a raw data text file of the last month's reports, and a Microsoft Excel data dictionary, and points to the IAEA event reporting website for events rated on the International Nuclear and Radiological Event Scale. Reports are free to read and download; as US government works they are in the public domain. Caveats: notifications are early reports made soon after an event and may later be retracted or revised, and only the last month is offered as a raw file, so older years must be read from the yearly indexes. Simulation uses are building event histories of reactor trips, loss of offsite power and weather-related shutdowns for hazard exposure, resilience and emergency response studies. Related records: data-nrc-power-reactor-status-reports gives daily reactor power levels, and data-iaea-news-ines-event-reports gives rated events worldwide.
